notes.title: Final Update Announcement
notes.content:
[h3][b]A Short Note[/b][/h3]

Hey everyone,

This marks the final update for Easy Breezy Drive. Developing this game has been an incredible journey, and I’ve learned so much along the way. A huge thank you to everyone who played! Your support, feedback, and love for the game have meant the world to me and made this journey unforgettable.

I’m stepping away to focus on further studies, but I hope to return in the future with even better games. Stay tuned, and thanks again for being part of this ride!

With gratitude,
[b]Easy Breezy Drive Dev[/b]

[b][i]*The game will remain purchasable and playable as it’s fully offline, so you can continue to enjoy those breezy drives.[/i][/b]


[h3][b]Update Changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Add Separate controls for Hazard Lights and Auto Drive (now activates with "Z" on Keyboard or "Face Button Left" or "X" on Xbox Controllers).
[*] Changed Night sky visuals in "Pine Valley".
[*] Days and Nights now last 3x longer in "Pine Valley" (same as every other map).
[*] Updated Game Credits.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1
notes.content:
Buckle up and hit the gas for a road trip unlike any other! Here's what's new in the latest Easy Breezy Drive update:

[b]Gameplay:[/b]

[list]
[*] New Map: Astral Voyage - Embark on a celestial journey beneath the breathtaking aurora borealis and the Milky Way with the moon as your guide. Experience a truly out-of-this-world atmosphere! Plus, experience music-synced road borders that illuminate your path!

[*] Brand New Music by Onycs and Rameses B. - Get ready to cruise to the tunes of two talented artists, Onyx and Rameses B. Their music will keep you company on every road trip.

[*] Revamped Camera System: We (well, me!) heard you loud and clear! Choose from three new camera modes to personalize your driving experience:

[list]
[*] [i]Close Cam:[/i] Get behind the vehicle for a more intimate and immersive perspective(quite similar to existing camera).
[*] [i]Far Cam:[/i] Soak in the scenery with a pulled-back view.
[*] [i]Dashboard Cam:[/i] A Fixed position camera perspective from the dashboard.
[/list]

[*] Smoother Rides: Level streaming has been optimized to significantly reduce loading times and hitching, ensuring a seamless journey.

[*] Loading Screen Makeover: Say goodbye to generic loading screens! Now, a beautiful image related to the level you're about to explore will greet you, setting the mood for your adventure.

[*] Level Selection Upgrade: Navigate to your next adventure with a brand new level selection screen, making it easier than ever to jump into your favorite drives.

[*] Pine Valley Revamp: Prepare to rediscover Pine Valley! I've completely reworked monument spawning to offer a more natural and engaging exploration experience. Additionally, I've added more environmental objects to enrich the world and revamped the grass visuals at night times for a more realistic and visually stunning landscape.
[/list]

[b]UI Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Credits Section: Enjoy a snappier performance in the credits section, no more crashes to interrupt your appreciation of the hard work put into this game :)

[*] Font Size Adjustments: Adjusted font sizes across many UI elements to ensure improved readability, making information easier to access.

[/list]

[b]More to Come:[/b] 
New levels and music are already in the works - stay tuned for even more exciting updates in the future!

[i]Note:[/i] The camera system is still under refinement and may have some minor issues. I appreciate your patience as  I continue to polish this feature.

That's a wrap! Update Easy Breezy Drive today and experience the open road in a whole new way!

notes.title: Added Features, Fixes
notes.content:
[b][h3][i]ADDITIONS-[/i][/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Added Cruise Control! Set your desired speed and enjoy a relaxing ride. Cruise Control deactivates when you touch the brake, gas pedal.
[*] Added new music collection by "Galaxy Tones" featuring their Chill Electronic music.
[/list]

[b][h3][i]IMPROVEMENTS[/i][/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Easy Breezy Drive can now be played offline! No internet connection required.
[*] Reduced level streaming loading stutter. This improvement may vary depending on your hardware. I'm continuing to optimize for a smooth experience for all users.
[/list]

[b]Happy Driving![/b]
